all-done.title: All done
all-done.description: A clipboard with every item checked off: a finished checklist, an inbox at zero, nothing left to review.

empty-box.title: Empty box
empty-box.description: An open, empty box: no items, no orders, nothing added to a collection yet.

empty-cart.title: Empty cart
empty-cart.description: An empty shopping cart: a cart or basket with no products in it.

empty-folder.title: Empty folder
empty-folder.description: An open folder with nothing inside: no files, no documents, an empty directory.

empty-inbox.title: Empty inbox
empty-inbox.description: An empty tray: an inbox, queue or feed with no entries.

error.title: Error
error.description: A cross in a red badge: an operation failed or could not be completed.

expired.title: Expired
expired.description: A clock with a warning badge: an expired session, link, trial or token.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.description: A locked padlock: access denied, sign-in required, a permission is missing.

idea.title: Idea
idea.description: A glowing light bulb: a tip, a suggestion, onboarding hints or a feature announcement.

info.title: Info
info.description: An i in an accent badge: neutral information or a notice.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: A rocket taking off: getting started, a first run, a release or an upgrade.

mail-sent.title: Mail sent
mail-sent.description: An envelope and a paper plane: a message, invitation or confirmation email was sent.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: A traffic cone: scheduled maintenance, work in progress, a feature under construction.

no-data.title: No data
no-data.description: A chart without data: an empty report, dashboard or time range.

no-events.title: No events
no-events.description: A blank calendar: no events, meetings or bookings scheduled.

no-messages.title: No messages
no-messages.description: Two speech bubbles: no conversations, comments or replies yet.

no-notifications.title: No notifications
no-notifications.description: A sleeping bell: no notifications, alerts or activity.

no-results.title: No results
no-results.description: A magnifier crossing out a page: a search or filter matched nothing.

no-users.title: No users
no-users.description: Two people and a plus badge: no members, contacts or collaborators yet; invite someone.

not-found.title: Not found
not-found.description: A page with a question mark: a 404, a missing page or a deleted record.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: A crossed-out cloud: no network connection, a service that cannot be reached.

search.title: Search
search.description: A magnifying glass: start searching, nothing searched yet.

secure.title: Secure
secure.description: A shield with a check mark: protected, verified, two-factor enabled.

server-error.title: Server error
server-error.description: A server stack with an error badge: a 500, an outage or a failed backend request.

success.title: Success
success.description: A check mark in a green badge: an operation completed successfully.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: A cloud with an upward arrow: drop files here, import or sync data.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: An exclamation mark in an amber triangle: something needs attention before continuing.
